- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via updateData (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation))_

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `updateData (4 routes)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **214** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **154** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **154**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **99** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `88d048ed0614a5ab30d5d81a6c8680a7c4173f67` — the merge of head `0acc8a19bedce53504aae3c85b2215a8a5757fb3` into base `7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 88d048ed0614a5ab30d5d81a6c8680a7c4173f67 && git checkout 88d048ed0614a5ab30d5d81a6c8680a7c4173f67
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608 0acc8a19bedce53504aae3c85b2215a8a5757fb3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608 && git merge --no-ff 0acc8a19bedce53504aae3c85b2215a8a5757fb3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7449e479c452394223ff5ab3a7af41c76a880608` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：按 id 更新记录时，先判断这次更新是否允许，再查记录在不在，和按 id 删除的顺序一致。覆盖单条 `PATCH`、`updateMany`、`batch`(update)三个入口，以及经过它们的 dispatcher `/data`、`/mcp` HTTP 工具和声明式更新动作。
- 为什么改：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)。
- 风险与回滚：没有编辑权限的调用方，或写入外部只读数据源的调用方，对不存在的 id 现在也收到 403,原来是 404。有权限的调用方仍然收到 404。成功更新、405、乐观锁、upsert 和系统上下文写入都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR,不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `updateData`,以及 `protocol-batch-data.ts` 的两处 update 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/update-by-id-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 16/16 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：收。席位逐行读了 `protocol.ts`、`protocol-batch-data.ts`、changeset 和文档段，确认三点：
- 存在性探测从引擎调用之前，移到了引擎返回 `null` 之后。
- 写操作被移出调用方行范围后仍回 `200 { record: null }`,原有语义保留。
- OCC 改用 `deleteData` 同一个 `assertVersionMatch`。

## 席位核对
1. 形态：draft、目标 main;按披露裁决不建卡，正文没有关闭关键词。正文首行是签名，`Clause-②`、`Metadata-protocol`、`Skills-docs` 三行都在。
2. 前提实测：基线 `bff315cd4` 上 dogfood 有 9/15 变红，复现了问题。ablation 把探测放回引擎之前，dogfood 有 6/16 变红、单元测试有 4/18 变红;恢复后全绿，dist 里的标记也已清除。
3. 门禁：本地 dispatch-gates 共 93 项，全部 exit 0。objectql 全套 510 个文件、9879 个测试通过。本 head 的 CI 共 50 项：38 success、12 skipped、0 失败；`Lint & Repo Gates`、`TypeScript Type Check`、`Test Core`(8 个分片全部)和 `Check Changeset` 都是 success。上一个 head `d0d3d0be0` 上 `Test Core (7/8)` 失败，原因是 `protocol-data.test.ts` 里 3 个用例还停在旧的探测顺序上。返工只改了这一个测试文件，没动源码；改后的断言更严：无版本号时引擎调用前不读记录，所有探测都是系统上下文，事后的存在性检查一定排在 `update` 之后。
4. 契约面：没有碰契约四面。`Clause-②: no`,这是一种拒绝换成另一种拒绝(404 换成 403),接受集不变，没有改 spec,也没有改受管文本。所以不欠达档复核，按「CI + 席位自读」处理。
5. 范围外去向：带 If-Match 失效版本的拒绝文案、upsert 按 id 的存在性分叉，这两条按披露裁决私下处理，不上 GitHub。ADR-0142:206 有一句过时的背景描述，属于受管面，本 PR 不碰。
6. 落地：不属于受管面，794 行，低于 3000 行上限 → `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`。
